question: How does pushing a globe make it spin like Earth?
answer: Your push lands away from the axis, so it makes a torque: a twist. Torque gives angular acceleration, so every push adds spin. Earth turns the same way, from a torque of its own.
move: A force off the axis makes a torque, and torque speeds up spin.
